checkpoint.title: Saffron to Cinnabar: Fly to Pallet Town, Surf down Route 21, heal at Cinnabar's Center

events.why: out of Saffron's Center onto the street below its door (24, 38): Fly works outdoors only
the Pidgey flies to Pallet Town, landing below the player's house door (6, 7) (pokeguy 1:18:59, from Fuchsia; here from Saffron)
south through the town to the shore (7..10, 17..19), a tile above the water, facing it (pokeguy bikes to Pallet's water edge, 1:19:00)
the lead's Surf (taught in 12.01): A at the water, YES, onto (8, 17)

south over Route 21's water (Pallet Town, Route21_North, Route21_South) to Cinnabar's north shore, off the water onto land and down to below the Center's door (14, 11); round the swimmers' and tuber's lines (pokeguy avoids them, 1:19:00 to 1:19:23)
the Center script in: through the door and up to the nurse; no map of the Center
full HP and PP before the Mansion's trainers

checkpoint: Starts at Saffron's nurse, facing her. Saffron's Silph Co. and Sabrina (rows after 16.01) are not authored, so this row's start is its own (starts_after_unauthored_rows()); it is where 16.01 begins, not where it ends. Ends at Cinnabar's nurse, facing her: 13.01's start (the Mansion).

Fly to Pallet Town, then Surf (HM03, taught to the lead in 12.01) down Route 21: pokeguy does the same from Fuchsia (1:18:59 to 1:19:23). No Seafoam Islands (user, 2026-11-12, design section 12). Route 21 is two maps (Route21_North, Route21_South) between Pallet Town and Cinnabar.

Route 21's water has wild encounters (Tentacool, Tentacruel) and its swimmers and tuber see one or four ways a tile or more: the planner keeps off their lines where the water allows. A trainer that does see the player is fought with the normal battle code, and the Center's nurse at the end heals.
